title: Creamy Broccoli and Parmesan Fettuccine
changes_from_base: Dried fettuccine in a cream sauce with pan-browned broccoli, lemon and Parmesan, in place of a simple butter-and-cheese finish on handmade egg pasta.
summary: Fettuccine with pan-browned broccoli simmered in cream, finished with lemon and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: large head broccoli (about 550 g), florets in 2.5 cm pieces, stalk peeled and thinly sliced
fine sea salt or table salt
fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 3.25 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: Parmesan (Parmigiano Reggiano) or a vegetarian hard cheese, finely grated

steps.title: Brown the broccoli
steps.text: Heat the butter and oil in the pan over medium-high heat until foaming. Add the broccoli and salt and cook about 5 min until browned in spots; the browning adds a nutty depth the cream would otherwise lack. Stir in the garlic for 30 s.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in 200 ml of the cream with the chilli, bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer 6-7 min until the broccoli is tender. The sauce will still be thin.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the fettuccine in 4 litres salted water until al dente. Save a mug of the water, drain and return to the pot.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the broccoli sauce and the remaining 100 ml cream and toss over medium heat 1-2 min until thickened. Off the heat, stir in the lemon zest, juice and Parmesan, adding water as needed for a glossy sauce.

tips: Let the broccoli sit undisturbed so it browns.
Slice the peeled stalk thinly so it cooks with the florets.
Add the lemon off the heat so the cream does not split.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
